scope: Read-only historical expense subset for the retained character; not all purchases or selected-route total
exclusions: The omitted nobility donation is excluded from this selection budget.
Reward fields named amount or paid_cp are not counted as spending.
Failed Desert Treasure bids do not charge and are excluded; successful price is a conservative gross expense before its100-silver credit.
remaining_expense_sources: Other generic equipment/tools and nonjournaled services, including initial weapons/gem composition inputs and variable Moon fare history.
Non-funding encounter healing/repair requirements remain dependent on encounter combat acceptance; do not assume the daily-boss model covers all encounters.
Natural RNG retry expense remains unbounded by observed controlled success-path totals.
limitations: Some recorded expenses support discarded attempts or nonselected achievements; the subset is not an exact minimum route price.
No bound-CP purchases occurred in the two reviewed currency-selectable journals; the query preserves that distinction for other characters.
Six wins is only an arithmetic funding comparison, not six additional earned kills or a promised calendar completion time.
No items, currencies, receipts or character snapshots were changed. Only the private PostgreSQL instance was started and stopped for read-only queries.
Supplemental amounts are a constructed conservative budget, not additional observed expense receipts. Actual runtime guild prices and shop catalogs must match the cited configurations at release.
The conservative collection allowance overlaps some CP cosmetic purchase receipts. It deliberately over-reserves those purchases; the subtotal is not claimed to be minimum expenditure.
